mapper.select:
select i.item_code as itemCode, i.item_name as itemName, coalesce(i.unit_name, i.unit_of_measure) as unit,
coalesce(s.balance, 0) - coalesce(t.sinceStart, 0) as opening, coalesce(t.incoming, 0) as incoming, coalesce(t.outgoing, 0) as outgoing, coalesce(s.balance, 0) - coalesce(t.afterEnd, 0) as balance,
coalesce(s.balance, 0) as balance,
count(*) over () as matchedCount from md_item i left join ( select item_id, sum(quantity_onhand) as balance from wm_material_stock group by item_id ) s on s.item_id = i.item_id
left join ( select item_id, sum(transaction_quantity) as sinceStart, sum(case when transaction_date >= date_add(#{to}, interval 1 day) then transaction_quantity else 0 end) as afterEnd, sum(case when transaction_flag = 1 and transaction_date < date_add(#{to}, interval 1 day) then transaction_quantity else 0 end) as incoming, sum(case when transaction_flag = -1 and transaction_date < date_add(#{to}, interval 1 day) then -transaction_quantity else 0 end) as outgoing from wm_transaction where transaction_date >= #{from} group by item_id ) t on t.item_id = i.item_id
where 1 = 1 order by i.item_code limit #{limit}

select item_code as itemCode, max(item_name) as itemName, coalesce(max(unit_name), unit_of_measure) as unit, sum(case when transaction_flag = 1 then transaction_quantity else 0 end) as incoming, sum(case when transaction_flag = -1 then -transaction_quantity else 0 end) as outgoing, sum(transaction_quantity) as net, count(*) as transactionCount, count(*) over () as matchedCount from wm_transaction where transaction_date >= #{from} and transaction_date < date_add(#{to}, interval 1 day) and transaction_flag = 1 and transaction_flag = -1
group by item_code, unit_of_measure order by transactionCount desc, item_code limit #{limit}

select w.workorder_code as workorderCode, w.workorder_name as workorderName, w.product_name as productName, coalesce(w.source_doc_code,w.source_code,'') as sourceOrderCode, w.quantity as planned, coalesce(w.quantity_produced, 0) as produced, round(100 * coalesce(w.quantity_produced, 0) / nullif(w.quantity, 0), 1) as progress, case w.status when 'PREPARE' then '草稿' when 'CONFIRMED' then '已确认' when 'FINISHED' then '已完工' when 'CANCELED' then '已取消' else w.status end as status, date_format(w.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as dueDate,
(select count(*) from pro_task t where t.workorder_id=w.workorder_id and coalesce(t.status,'') != 'CANCELED') as taskCount,
(select count(*) from qc_ipqc q where q.workorder_id=w.workorder_id and coalesce(q.status,'') not in ('CANCELED','FINISHED')) as pendingIpqc,
(select coalesce(sum(l.quantity_recived),0) from wm_product_recpt h join wm_product_recpt_line l on l.recpt_id=h.recpt_id where h.workorder_id=w.workorder_id and h.status='FINISHED' and l.item_id=w.product_id) as received,
(select coalesce(sum(l.quantity_sales),0) from wm_product_sales h join wm_product_sales_line l on l.sales_id=h.sales_id where l.workorder_id=w.workorder_id and h.status='FINISHED' and l.item_id=w.product_id) as shipped,
count(*) over () as matchedCount from pro_workorder w where coalesce(w.status,'') != 'DELETED' and lower(w.workorder_code) = lower(#{workorderCode})
and (locate(lower(#{query}), lower(w.workorder_code)) > 0 or locate(#{query}, w.workorder_name) > 0 or locate(#{query}, w.product_name) > 0 or locate(#{query}, w.product_code) > 0 or lower(w.source_doc_code) = lower(#{query}) or lower(w.source_code) = lower(#{query}))
and w.status = #{status} and w.request_date >= #{from} and w.request_date < date_add(#{to}, interval 1 day) and w.request_date < current_date and w.status not in ('FINISHED', 'CANCELED') order by w.request_date desc, w.workorder_id desc limit #{limit}
select item_id as itemId, item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName, (item_code = #{query} or item_name = #{query}) as exactMatch from md_item where 1 = 1 order by exactMatch desc, item_id limit 3

select item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName from md_item where item_name like concat(#{fragment}, '%') or item_code like concat(#{fragment}, '%') or item_name like concat('%', #{fragment}, '%') order by item_id limit 5

with recursive components as ( select b.bom_item_id, b.bom_item_code, b.bom_item_name, b.unit_name, b.unit_of_measure, cast(b.quantity as decimal(45, 10)) as totalQuantity, 1 as depth, cast(concat(',', b.item_id, ',', b.bom_item_id, ',') as char(255)) as visited from md_product_bom b where b.item_id = #{itemId} and b.enable_flag = 'Y' and b.bom_item_id != b.item_id union all select b.bom_item_id, b.bom_item_code, b.bom_item_name, b.unit_name, b.unit_of_measure, cast(c.totalQuantity * b.quantity as decimal(45, 10)), c.depth + 1, concat(c.visited, b.bom_item_id, ',') from components c join md_product_bom b on b.item_id = c.bom_item_id where b.enable_flag = 'Y' and c.depth < 6 and locate(concat(',', b.bom_item_id, ','), c.visited) = 0 ) select bom_item_code as itemCode, max(bom_item_name) as itemName, coalesce(max(unit_name), unit_of_measure) as unit, case when min(depth) = max(depth) then cast(min(depth) as char) else concat(min(depth), '–', max(depth)) end as depth, sum(totalQuantity) as quantity, count(*) over () as matchedCount from components group by bom_item_code, unit_of_measure order by min(depth), bom_item_code limit #{limit}

select item_code as itemCode, max(item_name) as itemName, count(*) as records, coalesce(sum(quantity_check), 0) as inspected, coalesce(sum(quantity_qualified), 0) as qualified, coalesce(sum(quantity_unqualified), 0) as unqualified, round(100 * sum(quantity_qualified) / nullif(sum(quantity_check), 0), 2) as passRate, round(100 * sum(quantity_unqualified) / nullif(sum(quantity_check), 0), 2) as failRate, count(*) over () as matchedCount
from qc_ipqc from qc_oqc from qc_iqc
where status = 'FINISHED' and inspect_date >= #{from} and inspect_date < date_add(#{to}, interval 1 day) and lower(workorder_code) = lower(#{workorderCode})
group by item_code order by records desc, item_code limit #{limit}

select item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName, specification, coalesce(unit_name, unit_of_measure) as unit, item_type_name as category, case enable_flag when 'Y' then '已启用' else '已停用' end as status, count(*) over () as matchedCount from md_item where 1 = 1 order by item_code limit #{limit}

select item_id as itemId, item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName, item_or_product as itemOrProduct, item_type_code as itemTypeCode, item_type_name as itemTypeName, coalesce(nullif(unit_name, ''), unit_of_measure) as unit, enable_flag as enableFlag from md_item where item_code = #{itemCode} order by item_id limit 1

select b.bom_id as bomId, cast(b.quantity as decimal(20, 4)) as quantity, coalesce(nullif(b.unit_name, ''), nullif(b.unit_of_measure, ''), nullif(ci.unit_name, ''), ci.unit_of_measure) as childUnit, b.bom_item_id as childId, p.item_id as parentId, p.item_code as parentCode, p.item_name as parentName, p.item_or_product as parentKind, p.item_type_code as parentTypeCode, p.item_type_name as parentTypeName, coalesce(nullif(p.unit_name, ''), p.unit_of_measure) as parentUnit from md_product_bom b join md_item p on p.item_id = b.item_id left join md_item ci on ci.item_id = b.bom_item_id where b.enable_flag = 'Y' and b.item_id <> b.bom_item_id and b.bom_item_id in #{childId} order by p.item_code, b.bom_id limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: select b.bom_id as bomId, cast(b.quantity as decimal(20, 4)) as quantity, b.enable_flag as enableFlag, b.bom_item_id as childId, coalesce(ci.item_code, b.bom_item_code) as childCode, coalesce(ci.item_name, b.bom_item_name) as childName, coalesce(nullif(b.unit_name, ''), nullif(b.unit_of_measure, ''), nullif(ci.unit_name, ''), ci.unit_of_measure) as childUnit, b.item_id as parentId, p.item_code as parentCode, p.item_name as parentName, p.item_or_product as parentKind, p.item_type_code as parentTypeCode, p.item_type_name as parentTypeName, coalesce(nullif(p.unit_name, ''), p.unit_of_measure) as parentUnit from md_product_bom b join md_item p on p.item_id = b.item_id left join md_item ci on ci.item_id = b.bom_item_id
mapper.select: select item_id as itemId, item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName from md_item where item_code in #{code} order by item_id limit 20

select item_id as itemId, item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName from md_item where enable_flag = 'Y' and char_length(item_name) >= 2 and locate(item_name, #{question}) > 0 order by char_length(item_name) desc, item_id limit #{limit}
